reason: I already reorder Toplux when it runs out and my drawer is full of half-used bottles. I'm not adding another one when I have a brand I trust.
objection: Why one form of magnesium when others have 8 forms in one capsule? Bisglycinate alone doesn't look like more to me, and I don't need another bottle in the drawer.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing that it works better than what I already take, for example a clear reason one form beats 8 forms, plus a price low enough that trying it costs me almost nothing.
